title: EPI-SST: Renewal-Structured State-Space Transformers for Epidemic Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2611.20352v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Epidemic forecasting supports public health decisions ranging from capacity planning to intervention timing, for which both point accuracy and calibrated uncertainty are essential. Although neural models have advanced point forecasting, producing reliable probabilistic predictions over multiple future horizons remains challenging. Renewal models encode epidemic propagation, while neural forecasters learn flexible multi-horizon representations; integrating these strengths within a probabilistic future rollout remains underexplored. We propose EPI-SST (Epidemic State Space Transformer), a probabilistic forecaster centered on an evidence-driven renewal transition. At each horizon, neural evidence produces a bounded update to an internal multiplier and advances a finite-memory renewal state that generates the future mean trajectory. A separate heteroscedastic Gaussian head controls predictive scale using a validation-selected log-variance pe

translated_title: EPI-SST：面向疫情预测的更新过程结构化状态空间Transformer
translated_abstract: 疫情预测为公共卫生决策提供支持，涵盖从资源容量规划到干预时机选择等多个方面，其中点预测精度和校准良好的不确定性都至关重要。尽管神经网络模型已推动了点预测的发展，但在多个未来时间步上产生可靠的概率预测仍具挑战性。更新模型能够编码疫情传播过程，而神经预测器可以学习灵活的多时间步表示；如何在概率化的未来滚动预测中整合这两者的优势仍缺乏深入研究。我们提出了EPI-SST（Epidemic State Space Transformer，流行病状态空间Transformer），这是一种以证据驱动的更新转移为核心的概率预测器。在每个预测时间步，神经证据对内部乘子产生有界更新，并推进具有有限记忆的更新状态，从而生成未来的均值轨迹。此外，一个独立的异方差高斯头通过验证集选择的对数方差惩罚来控制预测尺度……
tldr: 该论文提出EPI-SST，一种以证据驱动的有界更新转移为核心的状态空间Transformer概率预测模型，将更新过程对疫情传播的建模能力与神经网络的灵活多时间步表示相结合，实现兼顾点精度与校准不确定性的疫情概率预测。
en_tdlr: EPI-SST is a probabilistic state-space transformer that couples evidence-driven bounded renewal transitions with flexible neural representations to deliver accurate and well-calibrated multi-horizon epidemic forecasts.
